author: Fextralife
description:
Diablo 4 Lord of Hatred REVIEW - The Darkest Diablo Yet? Should you play? Expansion Review
In this Diablo 4 Lord of Hatred Review, We'll be taking a look at the second major expansion for Blizzard's ARPG. Last year we got a jungle themed expansion that brought back Mephisto. After the jungle trekking detour of Vessel of Hatred Blizzard is finally bringing back the big man himself, and we've spent dozens of hours in the Ancient Isle of Skovos, putting the massive system overhaul to the test and taking the new classes through the ringer. Is this the Reaper of Souls equivalent for Diablo 4? Let's find out.
